test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If sin θ = (11)/(12), then what will be the value of (tan θ + sec θ) ?
solution:
**Given:**

sin θ = 11/12

**Formula used:**

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

tan θ = sin θ / cos θ

sec θ = 1 / cos θ

**Calculation:**

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

⇒ (11/12)² + cos²θ = 1

⇒ 121/144 + cos²θ
